components.cost_effect: One component Oracle query, followed by vector arithmetic; full-gradient aggregation charges every component query.
components.goal: Expose the smooth component gradient from the component prox response.
components.key_estimate: The linked theorem gives grad f_i^(beta)(x)=beta(x-p_i), beta-smoothness and component bias <=L^2/(2beta). Averaging the component inequalities gives the same bias bound for their average.
components.name: Exact prox-to-gradient conversion
components.requires: The finite-dimensional Euclidean assumptions of the linked Moreau properties result and an exact prox response over the same X.
transfer_checks: Check that the prox domain equals the envelope domain and that beta uses the same convention.
Prove a separate error bound for approximate prox responses.
Specify and verify a downstream optimizer before claiming solution complexity.

limitations.statement: This selected simulation does not specify AGD, Katyusha or another complete optimizer, and does not assert their iteration bounds or unrestricted Oracle Complexity.
The average of component envelopes is generally different from the envelope of the average objective.

variants.cost: One h_F call per component gradient; m calls per full gradient. Vector subtraction/scaling requires O(d) arithmetic per component; streaming averaging uses O(d) working storage. These arithmetic costs are separate from Oracle-call accounting. Internal exact-prox computation is inside the assumed Oracle and is not asserted to be free in an implementation. No envelope-value evaluation is included.
variants.implementation_details_ref: PDF p.4, Section 3, Eqs.(4)–(5); PDF p.1, Eqs.(2)–(3)
variants.name: Exact component-gradient simulation
variants.output: Return g_i=grad f_i^(beta)(x); optionally return (1/m) sum_i g_i=grad[(1/m) sum_i f_i^(beta)](x). The output is a gradient vector, not an epsilon-optimal solution.
public_inputs: Nonempty closed convex X subset of R^d; finite convex L-Lipschitz components f_1,...,f_m on X; m>=2; L>0; beta>0.
Query point x in X and selected index i in {1,...,m}.
variants.query_and_update: Issue h_F(x,i,beta). Extract its prox output p_i and compute g_i=beta(x-p_i). No iterative optimizer update is part of this variant. To obtain a full gradient at x, perform this operation for all i and average the vectors.
variants.requirements: The Oracle must return p_i=argmin_{u in X}[f_i(u)+(beta/2)||x-u||^2]. Original component gradients alone do not supply this operation.
variants.state_and_initialization: Stateless simulation. Initialize with the supplied x,i,beta and access to Eq.(2)'s exact component Oracle.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Stop after the single component query, or after m queries for a full gradient. beta is fixed by the caller. The source's choice beta=L^2/epsilon, epsilon>0, sets the uniform objective smoothing bias to at most epsilon/2. The downstream optimizer and its stopping certificate are separate inputs, not specified by this component.

summary: An executable component Oracle simulation: one exact component prox query produces the gradient of its Moreau envelope. This record covers the simulation component rather than an unspecified optimizer.
title: Component Moreau prox-to-gradient simulation
use_when: Implement smooth component gradients using an available exact component prox Oracle.
